name: g29_trick_lock_before_move
purpose: A Prankster Trick takes a Choice Scarf from an Annihilape that has locked into Close Combat the turn before, before it moves: the lock stays through the trade (a Life Orb is not a Choice item) and ends in choicelock's onBeforeMove when the Annihilape moves (Close Combat again, which knocks out the Kingambit: the turn stops for the replacement with the lock gone and the Life Orb's recoil taken).
